text:
Maya: Heads-up — recurring kv-cache noise at 03:38 UTC, generated 3 pages in ~12m. Filing follow-up and linking postmortem. https://incidents.redwood/10012
Dan: I saw 3 pages. pattern looks identical to last month's burst; dedupe didn't collapse them.
Kevin: can someone paste the alert rule? suspect eval window too short.
Maya: rule excerpt:
```
alert: kvcache_high_errors
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_errors_total[1m])) by (shard) > 50
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kvcache
```
Sophia: immediate proposals: extend eval to 5m, add dedupe label deployment+shard, and convert transient spikes into tickets instead of pages.
Nate: also propose suppression: if identical metric identity fires >3x within 6m, collapse to single page and mute for 10m; escalate on sustained growth.
Tara: I can own changes — will open PR to infra-alerts with for:5m, new dedupe labels, and a severity toggle for canary. ETA 3h for PR to staging.
Maya: Assignments: Tara implement, Kevin review, Maya validate post-deploy. Plan: PR today, test in staging 6h, prod gradual rollout tomorrow morning.
Kevin: will review within 4h. suggest adding ci/unit tests for suppression behavior.
IncidentBot: alert kvcache_high_errors triggered 2026-03-08T03:38:10Z -> pages:3, resolved 2026-03-08T03:50:05Z, incident: https://incidents.redwood/10012
Tara: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/477 — includes 5m window, dedupe labels, suppression logic, and tests. CI green. PTAL @Kevin @Maya
Kevin: Reviewing now. Minor naming nit on label but otherwise LGTM.
Maya: Post-deploy checklist: merge PR, monitor staging 6h, roll prod 10/30/60, add dashboard for 5m per-shard rate, add metric "pages_avoided_by_dedupe" for telemetry.
Nate: I'll file an ops ticket for the deploy-smoke test to check kv-cache error rate post-deploy. ETA next sprint.
Tara: Merged and rolling to staging. Monitoring.
Maya: Staging 2h looks stable, no new pages. Scheduling prod rollout at 08:00 UTC tomorrow.
Dan: For paging policy, propose: <10m resolve -> ticket; >=10m sustained -> page; immediate page for known critical signals. Document exceptions in runbook.
Sophia: I'll draft precise runbook wording and exception list.
Maya: Action recap (owners & ETAs): Tara: implement/PR (done), Kevin: review (done), Maya: validate + update runbook (tomorrow AM), Nate: ops ticket for smoke test (next sprint), Dan: add dedupe telemetry (next week), Sophia: draft paging policy text (next week).
Maya: I'll update the postmortem with owners/timeline and close this loop after 7 days of telemetry. Ping here for updates. :white_check_mark:
